about-us.html:
About Us

Empowering Smiles, Changing Lives

About us

The Lata Agrawal Foundation is a nonprofit organization dedicated to making a lasting impact on society by addressing critical issues such as hunger, education, healthcare, and social empowerment. Founded on the principles of compassion and service, we work to uplift underprivileged communities and equip them with the resources and opportunities needed for a better future.

At the core of our mission is the belief that every individual deserves access to basic necessities and the chance to thrive. Through innovative programs and strategic partnerships, we are committed to fighting hunger, promoting education, improving healthcare access, and empowering women and children.

With a focus on sustainability and long-term impact, the Lata Agrawal Foundation envisions a more equitable and inclusive society. Join us in our journey to bring hope and change to those who need it the most. Together, we can make a difference.

Our Mission

We aim to bridge the education gap by providing essential resources, mentorship, and opportunities to underprivileged children, empowering them to achieve their full potential. Education is the cornerstone of progress and a fundamental right that transforms lives and communities.

Through our initiatives, we provide access to quality learning materials, scholarships, and skill development programs to ensure that every child, regardless of their background, has the opportunity to succeed. Our mentorship programs inspire and guide young minds, fostering confidence and helping them envision a brighter future.

By addressing barriers to education such as poverty, lack of resources, and limited access, we strive to create a generation of empowered individuals ready to lead meaningful lives and contribute positively to society. Together, we can build a future where every child has the tools and opportunities they need to thrive.

Our Vision

We envision a world where every child has access to quality education, empowering them to realize their potential and contribute meaningfully to society.

At the heart of our vision is the belief that education is a fundamental right and a powerful force for breaking the cycle of poverty. We strive for a future where no child is deprived of learning due to socio-economic barriers, geographic challenges, or lack of resources.

Through a holistic approach, we aim to build an inclusive educational ecosystem that nurtures curiosity, creativity, and critical thinking. Our programs not only provide access to education but also equip children with the tools, mentorship, and support they need for well-rounded development.

We are committed to collaborating with communities, educators, and policymakers to create opportunities for every child to thrive. Our vision extends beyond classrooms, fostering a generation of empowered individuals who can shape a sustainable and equitable world for all.

Our Team

Behind every initiative at the Lata Agrawal Foundation is a dedicated team of educators, volunteers, and supporters who work tirelessly to create meaningful change. Our team is united by a shared commitment to uplifting underprivileged communities and ensuring that every child has access to quality education, healthcare, and essential resources.

Who We Are:

👩‍🏫 Educators & Mentors – Passionate teachers and mentors who guide, inspire, and nurture young minds.
🙌 Volunteers & Supporters – Selfless individuals who contribute their time, skills, and resources to support our cause.
🤝 Strategic Partners – Organizations and institutions that collaborate with us to expand our reach and impact.

Together, we are more than just a team—we are a community of changemakers working towards a brighter, more equitable future for all. With every project we undertake, we strive to create lasting impact and sustainable solutions that empower those in need.

Frequently Asked Questions

I don't live in Wardha, How can I help?

You can courier above listed items to our office or you can also purchase the same online and mention our address as delivery address. Thousands of our donors are doing the same for years.

Where is your collection centre?

Lata Agrawal Foundation, 

48 Mohini Nagar, Behind Arti Talkies, 

Wardha Maharashtra 442001

Can I speak to someone at your office?

For any queries and details, please speak to Samir Agrawal at 9421095604 (Best time to call between 10:00am to 5:00pm) or please write to him at admin@agrawalfoundation.org

Are you open on Sundays?

We are open all 7 Days between 9:00am to 5:00pm

Do you accept donation of lightly used toys, clothes, etc.?

Yes, if you feel your toys or clothes are in good condition, you may consider donating the same.

Do you accept donations of food?

You can consider donating packets of biscuits, cake, dry fruits, tetra pack juice etc.

Can I make financial contribution to the LATA AGRAWAL FOUNDATION?

We welcome monetary donations. Please make the cheque in favour of “Lata Agrawal Foundation” and mail it to :-

Lata Agrawal Foundation, 

48 Mohini Nagar, Behind Arti Talkies, 

Wardha Maharashtra 442001

Bank Name: HDFC Bank

Account Name: Lata Agrawal Foundation

Type: Checking 

A/c No: 50200097041761

IFSC Code: HDFC0000965

(Donations are eligible for tax exemption under section 80G of Income Tax Act 1961)

Can I join Lata Agrawal Foundation team ?

Yes, We encourage you, your family and friends to join us to be a part of our charitable activities, Please call us at : +91.94.2109 5604 or write to admin@agrawalfoundation.org to join.

Can you pick-up the stuff from my home?

It is not practically possible for us to collect any stuff from your home as all our team members are busy in distribution of your kind help in entire India. We humbly request you to please drop your help at our collection centre only.

become-a-volunteer.html:
Become a Volunteer

Why Volunteer?

Volunteering with the Lata Agrawal Foundation is an opportunity to make a real difference in the lives of those in need. By contributing your time, skills, and passion, you become an essential part of our mission to uplift underprivileged communities and create a more equitable society.

As a volunteer, you’ll have the chance to:

  • Impact Lives: Help provide food, education, healthcare, and support to those who need it the most.
  • Develop Skills: Gain valuable experience in community service, project management, and leadership.
  • Build Connections: Work alongside like-minded individuals who share your commitment to social change.
  • Inspire Hope: Be a source of encouragement and positivity for the people we serve.

Your efforts, big or small, can bring meaningful change and contribute to building a brighter future. Join us in our journey to create a world where every individual has the opportunity to thrive. Together, we can make a lasting impact.

How to Get Involved

Getting involved with the Lata Agrawal Foundation is easy and rewarding. Whether you want to volunteer, donate, or support our initiatives, your contribution can make a meaningful impact. Here’s how you can join our mission:

  1. Volunteer with Us:
    Dedicate your time and skills to support our programs. From organizing food drives to mentoring children, there are countless ways to make a difference.

  2. Make a Donation:
    Your financial support helps us provide food, education, healthcare, and other essential resources to underserved communities. Every contribution, big or small, brings us closer to our goals.

  3. Partner with Us:
    Collaborate with us as a corporate or community partner to create sustainable solutions and amplify our impact.

  4. Spread the Word:
    Help raise awareness about our mission by sharing our story and encouraging others to get involved.

  5. Join Our Events:
    Participate in our fundraising and awareness campaigns to support our cause and connect with like-minded individuals.

To Join Please Fill Out the Form Below

Food

Food Donation & The Role of NGOs in India

Food donation plays a vital role in combating hunger and ensuring food security for millions in India. NGOs act as crucial intermediaries, bridging the gap between surplus food from donors and underserved communities. They organize food distribution drives, raise awareness about hunger issues, and collaborate with individuals, businesses, and government bodies to address the issue of malnutrition. The Lata Agrawal Foundation is deeply committed to this cause, working tirelessly to provide nutritious meals to those in need. By leveraging its extensive network and resources, the foundation strives to make a meaningful impact on hunger alleviation, particularly among marginalized groups. Through its initiatives, the foundation not only delivers meals but also promotes sustainable solutions to eradicate hunger, fostering a healthier and more equitable society. Join the Lata Agrawal Foundation in its mission to fight hunger and create a brighter, food-secure future for India.

Supporting children’s education through books is a powerful way to positively impact the next generation of readers and learners. Book lovers unite in the collective effort to provide children with access to quality literature that can inspire imagination, foster curiosity, and spark a lifelong love of learning. By donating books to schools, libraries, and organizations serving children in need, you can help bridge the educational opportunity gap and promote literacy among young minds. Join us in this noble cause and be a champion for children’s education through the simple act of sharing the magic of books. Your contribution, no matter how small, can make a big difference in shaping the future of our youth. Let’s come together and support children’s education through book donations – because every child deserves the chance to explore the wonders of the written word.
